items.title: Southern California swelters as late-season heatwave smothers region
items.description: <p>Temperatures expected to hover around 100F in downtown LA and even hotter inland, raising concerns about wildfires</p><p>Southern California faced scorching heatwaves this summer that made locals wonder what happened to their famed Mediterranean climate.</p><p>Now, the fall is bringing heatwaves too.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/03/southern-california-late-season-heatwave">Continue reading...</a>

items.title: Worst ever outbreak of bluetongue hits British farms
items.description: <p>Climate crisis blamed as virus that originated in Africa spreads to livestock as far north as Aberdeenshire</p><p>British farmers are experiencing the worst bluetongue season on record, with the number of cases surpassing the past three years combined.</p><p>The viral disease, which affects sheep and cattle among other animals, can cause fevers, ulcers, a swollen head and lameness. items.title: Bangkok at breaking point as floods turn streets into stagnant lakes
items.description: <p>With 40 dead and a disaster declared across all 50 city districts, experts warn extreme flooding will only worsen across south-east Asia</p><p>Bangkok is used to absorbing the sudden afternoon downpours that inundate the city during the rainy season. Even streets in many central high-rise districts can briefly turn into rivers, with rats and cockroaches racing out of sewers and taking temporary refuge on trees and buildings as the subterranean world is flushed out.</p>

items.title: Protesters across Spain demand action over housing crisis
items.description: More than 50 protests are taking place on Saturday after the government failed to get emergency legislation through parliament.

items.title: Bosnia-Herzegovina shaped by war, separatism, EU ambitions
items.description: Bosnia-Herzegovina is governed by a system established after the Bosnian war — more than 30 years ago. Ethnic divisions, a complex administration and European integration all shape the country's political reality.

items.title: Spain's parliament rejects housing bill as protests continue
items.description: Spain's minority government suffered defeat in parliament as it tried to push through a pair of emergency measures aimed at making housing more affordable. A pensioner's eviction and protests led to the bid.
